fire_rule: Let y_t be 1 if planted credential t is detected by the named scanner (file-path match; secret values never used) and 0 otherwise. Fire at the smallest t >= min_sources such that mean(y_{t-window+1} .. y_t) >= floor. Silent if no such t exists. This is a coverage-attained detector, not a novelty-drop stopper.
miss_rate_definition: If the detector fires at t*, miss_count is the number of plants with y_t=0 at any index (undetected plants). miss_rate = miss_count / n_plants. If the detector never fires, miss_count is still the undetected count (coverage never attained) and miss_rate is reported, not null.
citation: Catalog RES-0133: detection rate of gitleaks, trufflehog, and GitHub secret scanning over 40 planted format-valid synthetic credentials across 10 provider formats in markdown prose, JSONL transcripts, and fenced code blocks; 5 credential-shaped non-credentials for precision. Floor 0.6 is rolling mean detection >= 60% over a window of 5 plants. Numbers frozen before any scanner was invoked on this worktree.
github_hosted_secret_scanning: not-invoked; local regex engine from published GitHub secret-scanning token types only
